QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_58

question.text: Vishesh AIF pays Trusteeship Fees of INR 3 lakh per year. GST at 18% applies. Total annual cost to the fund for trusteeship (incl. GST):

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Trusteeship fee: INR 3 lakh. GST 18%: 3 × 0.18 = 0.54 lakh. Total = INR 3.54 lakh. **The Trap:** Option A ignores GST. Option B uses wrong rate. Option D rounds. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-A/B tests GST on professional fees; III-A/C (Compliance) covers tax treatment. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** GST on trusteeship is typically not recoverable by AIF (no output services) — a dead cost. Trust Deed should clarify who bears GST increase if rates change mid-fund life.
